text: Enter your UPI PIN to receive ₹5,000 cashback.
label: SCAM
explanation: Receiving money should not require sharing or entering a UPI PIN for an unknown request.
action: Do not enter your UPI PIN.

text: Scan this QR code to receive your refund of ₹2,500.
label: SCAM
explanation: Fraudsters may use QR codes to trick users into authorizing payments.
action: Do not scan unknown QR codes for receiving money.

text: You won ₹10,000. Approve the collect request and enter your UPI PIN.
label: SCAM
explanation: A collect request can result in money leaving your account.

text: Your payment failed. Enter your UPI PIN again to receive a refund.
label: SCAM
explanation: Uses a fake refund scenario to obtain payment authorization.
action: Verify the transaction in your official payment app.

text: We accidentally sent you money. Approve the request and enter your UPI PIN to return it.
label: SCAM
explanation: May attempt to trick the user into authorizing a payment.
action: Verify directly in your UPI app.

text: Complete this reward withdrawal by entering your UPI PIN.
label: SCAM
explanation: Uses a reward promise to obtain payment authorization.
action: Do not enter your UPI PIN.

text: You have received ₹500 from Rahul via UPI.
label: SAFE
action: Verify the transaction in your payment app if needed.

text: Your UPI payment of ₹250 to Merchant Store was successful.
label: SAFE
action: Review the transaction details if you did not authorize it.

text: A payment request of ₹300 has been received. Review the request carefully before approving.
label: SAFE
explanation: A payment request notification itself is not necessarily fraudulent.
action: Review the requester and amount before taking action.

text: Your UPI transaction was declined due to insufficient balance.
label: SAFE
action: Check your account through the official app.
